adaptedFrom.note: Substantially rewritten for Pocket. The original is OpenClaw-specific and ~5,300 tokens, built around shell commands that create a .learnings/ directory plus an opt-in hooks system. Pocket loads instructions and never executes scripts, so the mkdir/printf bootstrap and hook mechanism were dropped and the storage location left to the workspace. Reduced to ~950 tokens by cutting the multi-agent compatibility notes and command reference, while keeping the Pattern-Key deduplication idea, the recurrence counter and the read-before-acting discipline, which are the parts that make it work.
